  /* ---------- calendar ---------- */
  function buildCal(){
    var grid=document.getElementById('calGrid');
    document.getElementById('calMonth').textContent=MON[calM]+' '+calY;
    var cur=calY*12+calM;
    document.getElementById('calPrev').disabled=cur<=minYM;
    document.getElementById('calNext').disabled=cur>=maxYM;
    var first=new Date(calY,calM,1).getDay();
    var days=new Date(calY,calM+1,0).getDate();
    var byDay={};
    EVENTS.forEach(function(ev){var d=pd(ev.s);if(d.getFullYear()===calY&&d.getMonth()===calM){(byDay[d.getDate()]=byDay[d.getDate()]||[]).push(ev);}});
    var html=DOW.map(function(x){return '<div class="cal__dow">'+x[0]+'</div>';}).join('');
    for(var p=0;p<first;p++)html+='<div class="cal__day pad"></div>';
    for(var day=1;day<=days;day++){
      var evs=byDay[day];
      if(evs){var key=calY+'-'+calM+'-'+day;
        html+='<button class="cal__day ev'+(key===selKey?' sel':'')+'" data-day="'+day+'">'+day+'<span class="cal__dot"></span></button>';
      } else html+='<div class="cal__day">'+day+'</div>';
    }
    grid.innerHTML=html;
    grid.querySelectorAll('.cal__day.ev').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){selectDay(+b.dataset.day);});
    });
    var firstDay=Object.keys(byDay).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;})[0];
    if(firstDay){if(!document.querySelector('.cal__day.sel')){selectDay(firstDay);} else {renderDetail();}}
    else {document.getElementById('calDetail').innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--slate)">No events this month.</p>';}
  }
  function selectDay(day){
    selKey=calY+'-'+calM+'-'+day;
    document.querySelectorAll('.cal__day.ev').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('sel',+b.dataset.day===day);});
    renderDetail();
  }
  function renderDetail(){
    var parts=selKey?selKey.split('-').map(Number):null;
    var det=document.getElementById('calDetail');
    if(!parts){det.innerHTML='';return;}
    var evs=EVENTS.filter(function(ev){var d=pd(ev.s);return d.getFullYear()===parts[0]&&d.getMonth()===parts[1]&&d.getDate()===parts[2];});
    det.innerHTML=evs.map(function(ev,i){return evCardHTML(ev,i);}).join('');
    thumbErrors(det);revealIn(det);wireEvDetails(det);
  }
  document.getElementById('calPrev').addEventListener('click',function(){if(calY*12+calM>minYM){calM--;if(calM<0){calM=11;calY--;}selKey=null;buildCal();}});
  document.getElementById('calNext').addEventListener('click',function(){if(calY*12+calM<maxYM){calM++;if(calM>11){calM=0;calY++;}selKey=null;buildCal();}});

  /* ---------- initial render + live sync from /api/events ---------- */
  computeRange();renderAll();
  fetch('/api/events').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(d){
    if(d&&d.events){EVENTS=d.events;PAST=d.past||[];computeRange();renderAll();}
  }).catch(function(){});

  /* ---------- gallery + lightbox ---------- */
  var GALLERY=[
    {k:'atmo_fremont1',c:'Fremont Brewing · Seattle'},
    {k:'gal_smnw43',c:'Live on the block'},
    {k:'atmo_286',c:'In the crowd'},
    {k:'gal_smnw36',c:'On stage'},
    {k:'atmo_fremont3',c:'Fremont Brewing · photo Giao Nguyen'},
    {k:'gal_smnw20',c:'A full house'},
    {k:'atmo_r000',c:'Summer in the park'},
    {k:'gal_traf',c:'Trafestival · Seattle'},
    {k:'atmo_158',c:'Neighborhood set'},
    {k:'atmo_fremont2',c:'Neighbors gathered'},
    {k:'gal_img4',c:'Behind the scenes'},
    {k:'atmo_80',c:'The band plays on'},
    {k:'gal_dsc',c:'A live moment'}
  ].filter(function(g){return IMAGES[g.k];});
  var galleryGrid=document.getElementById('galleryGrid');
  function galDefault(){return GALLERY.map(function(g){return {src:'b:'+g.k,cap:g.c};});}
  var galItems=galDefault();
  var lbi=0,dragI=null;
  function galEsc(s){return (s==null?'':String(s)).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c];});}
  function galResolve(src){ if(!src)return ''; if(src.indexOf('u:')===0)return '/api/photo?id='+encodeURIComponent(src.slice(2)); if(src.indexOf('b:')===0)return IMAGES[src.slice(2)]||''; if(/^https?:|^data:/.test(src))return src; return IMAGES[src]||''; }
  function galInit(){ if(CONTENT['gallery']){try{var a=JSON.parse(CONTENT['gallery']);if(Array.isArray(a))galItems=a;}catch(e){}} renderGallery();buildCarousel(); }
  function galDirty(){ dirty['gallery']=JSON.stringify(galItems); updateBar(); }
  function renderGallery(){
    if(!galleryGrid)return;
    var ed=document.body.classList.contains('editing');
    var tools=document.getElementById('galTools'); if(tools)tools.hidden=!ed;
    galleryGrid.innerHTML=galItems.map(function(it,i){
      return '<figure data-i="'+i+'">'
        +'<img src="'+galResolve(it.src)+'" alt="'+galEsc(it.cap)+'" loading="lazy">'
        +'<figcaption'+(ed?' contenteditable="true" spellcheck="false"':'')+'>'+galEsc(it.cap)+'</figcaption>'
        +(ed?'<button class="gal-grip" title="Drag to reorder" tabindex="-1" draggable="true">&#9776;</button><button class="gal-del" title="Remove photo" tabindex="-1">&#10005;</button>':'')
        +'</figure>';
    }).join('')+(ed?'<button class="gal-add" id="galAdd" type="button">+ Add photos</button>':'');
    wireGallery(ed);
  }
  function wireGallery(ed){
    if(!galleryGrid)return;
    if(!ed){ galleryGrid.querySelectorAll('figure').forEach(function(f){f.addEventListener('click',function(){openLb(+f.dataset.i);});}); return; }
    galleryGrid.querySelectorAll('figure').forEach(function(f){
      var i=+f.dataset.i;
      f.querySelector('figcaption').addEventListener('input',function(e){galItems[i].cap=e.currentTarget.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();galDirty();});
      f.querySelector('.gal-del').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();galItems.splice(i,1);galDirty();renderGallery();});
      f.querySelector('img').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();galReplace(i);});
      var grip=f.querySelector('.gal-grip');
      if(grip){grip.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){dragI=i;f.classList.add('dragging');e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';try{e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',String(i));}catch(_){}});grip.addEventListener('dragend',function(){f.classList.remove('dragging');});}
      f.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){e.preventDefault();f.classList.add('drop-t');});
      f.addEventListener('dragleave',function(){f.classList.remove('drop-t');});
      f.addEventListener('drop',function(e){e.preventDefault();f.classList.remove('drop-t');var to=+f.dataset.i;if(dragI==null||dragI===to)return;var mv=galItems.splice(dragI,1)[0];galItems.splice(to,0,mv);dragI=null;galDirty();renderGallery();});
    });
    var add=document.getElementById('galAdd');
    if(add){
      add.addEventListener('click',function(){var inp=document.createElement('input');inp.type='file';inp.accept='image/*';inp.multiple=true;inp.onchange=function(){galUpload(inp.files);};inp.click();});
      add.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){e.preventDefault();add.classList.add('over');});
      add.addEventListener('dragleave',function(){add.classList.remove('over');});
      add.addEventListener('drop',function(e){e.preventDefault();add.classList.remove('over');if(e.dataTransfer&&e.dataTransfer.files&&e.dataTransfer.files.length)galUpload(e.dataTransfer.files);});
    }
  }
  function galReplace(i){var inp=document.createElement('input');inp.type='file';inp.accept='image/*';inp.onchange=function(){var f=inp.files&&inp.files[0];if(!f)return;galUploadFile(f,function(src){galItems[i].src=src;galDirty();renderGallery();});};inp.click();}
  function galUpload(files){Array.prototype.slice.call(files).forEach(function(f){if(!/^image\//.test(f.type))return;galUploadFile(f,function(src){galItems.push({src:src,cap:''});galDirty();renderGallery();});});}
  function galUploadFile(file,cb){
    var add=document.getElementById('galAdd'); if(add){add.classList.add('busy');add.textContent='Uploading…';}
    resizeImg(file,1500,0.72,function(dataUri){
      fetch('/api/upload',{method:'POST',headers:{'x-admin-key':adminKey(),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({image:dataUri})})
        .then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(res){
          if(add){add.classList.remove('busy');add.textContent='+ Add photos';}
          if(res&&res.id){cb('u:'+res.id);} else {alert('Upload failed. Try a smaller image.');}
        }).catch(function(){if(add){add.classList.remove('busy');add.textContent='+ Add photos';}alert('Upload error.');});
    });
  }
  var galResetBtn=document.getElementById('galReset');
  if(galResetBtn)galResetBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){ if(!confirm('Reset the gallery to the original photos? This clears added photos, captions, and custom order.'))return; galItems=galDefault(); galDirty(); renderGallery(); });
  var lb=document.getElementById('lightbox'),lbImg=document.getElementById('lbImg'),lbCap=document.getElementById('lbCap');
  function openLb(i){ if(!galItems.length)return; lbi=(i+galItems.length)%galItems.length; var it=galItems[lbi]; lbImg.src=galResolve(it.src); lbImg.alt=it.cap||''; lbCap.textContent=it.cap||''; lb.hidden=false; document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; }
  function closeLb(){lb.hidden=true;document.body.style.overflow='';}
  if(lb){
    document.getElementById('lbClose').addEventListener('click',closeLb);
    document.getElementById('lbPrev').addEventListener('click',function(){openLb(lbi-1);});
    document.getElementById('lbNext').addEventListener('click',function(){openLb(lbi+1);});
    lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===lb)closeLb();});
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(lb.hidden)return;if(e.key==='Escape')closeLb();else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')openLb(lbi-1);else if(e.key==='ArrowRight')openLb(lbi+1);});
  }
  renderGallery();

  /* ---------- home carousel (reuses gallery photos) ---------- */
  var carI=0,carN=0,carTimer=null,carReduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function carGo(i){
    if(!carN)return;carI=(i+carN)%carN;
    var track=document.getElementById('carTrack');if(track)track.style.transform='translateX(-'+(carI*100)+'%)';
    var dots=document.getElementById('carDots');if(dots)dots.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b,j){b.classList.toggle('on',j===carI);});
  }
  function carStop(){if(carTimer){clearInterval(carTimer);carTimer=null;}}
  function carRestart(){carStop();if(carReduce||carN<2)return;carTimer=setInterval(function(){carGo(carI+1);},4500);}
  function buildCarousel(){
    var wrap=document.getElementById('carousel');if(!wrap)return;
    var track=document.getElementById('carTrack'),dots=document.getElementById('carDots');
    var items=(galItems||[]).filter(function(it){return galResolve(it.src);});
    if(!items.length){wrap.style.display='none';if(dots)dots.style.display='none';return;}
    wrap.style.display='';if(dots)dots.style.display='';
    track.innerHTML=items.map(function(it){var src=galResolve(it.src);return '<div class="carousel__slide"><div class="carousel__bg" style="background-image:url(\''+src+'\')"></div><img class="carousel__img" src="'+src+'" alt="'+galEsc(it.cap)+'" loading="lazy">'+(it.cap?'<div class="carousel__cap">'+galEsc(it.cap)+'</div>':'')+'</div>';}).join('');
    dots.innerHTML=items.map(function(_,i){return '<button type="button" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Photo '+(i+1)+'"></button>';}).join('');
    dots.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){carGo(+b.dataset.i);carRestart();});});
    carN=items.length;carGo(0);carRestart();
  }
  (function(){
    var prev=document.getElementById('carPrev'),next=document.getElementById('carNext'),wrap=document.getElementById('carousel');
    if(prev)prev.addEventListener('click',function(){carGo(carI-1);carRestart();});
    if(next)next.addEventListener('click',function(){carGo(carI+1);carRestart();});
    if(wrap){wrap.addEventListener('mouseenter',carStop);wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave',carRestart);}
  })();
  buildCarousel();

  /* ---------- reveal ---------- */
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}});},{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
  function observeAll(){document.querySelectorAll('.reveal:not(.in)').forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});}
  function revealIn(scope){(scope||document).querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in');});}
  observeAll();

  /* ---------- router ---------- */
  var views={home:'v-home',approach:'v-approach',events:'v-events',gallery:'v-gallery',about:'v-about',donate:'v-donate',blockstage:'v-blockstage'};
  var navLinks=document.querySelectorAll('.nav__links a');
  function setActiveNav(name){navLinks.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle('on',a.dataset.go===name);});}
  function showView(name,scrollTarget){
    if(!views[name])name='home';
    Object.keys(views).forEach(function(k){document.getElementById(views[k]).classList.toggle('active',k===name);});
    setActiveNav(name);
    // list + footer sections always visible; hide mailing list on none — keep it global
    if(name!=='home'){revealIn(document.getElementById(views[name]));}
    else{observeAll();}
    if(name==='events'){showEv('list');}
    if(scrollTarget){
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){var t=document.getElementById(scrollTarget);if(t)t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});});
    } else {window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'auto'});}
  }
  function go(name,scrollTarget){location.hash=name==='home'?'':('#'+name);showView(name,scrollTarget);}
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(document.body.classList.contains('editing'))return;go(el.dataset.go,el.dataset.scroll);});
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll]:not([data-go])').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(document.body.classList.contains('editing'))return;var t=document.getElementById(el.dataset.scroll);if(t)t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});});
  });
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',function(){showView(location.hash.replace('#','')||'home');});
  var initial=location.hash.replace('#','')||'home';
  if(initial!=='home'){showView(initial);}

  /* ---------- nav solid on scroll ---------- */
  var nav=document.getElementById('nav');
  function onScroll(){nav.classList.toggle('solid',window.scrollY>40);}
  onScroll();window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});

  /* ---------- hero intro (home only) ---------- */
  var reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var seal=document.getElementById('seal'),bloom=document.getElementById('bloom');
  function land(){body.classList.remove('booting');body.style.removeProperty('height');}
  if(initial==='home'){
    body.classList.add('booting');
    if(reduce){land();}
    else{
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){seal.classList.add('play');bloom.classList.add('play');});
      var t=setTimeout(land,2050);
      window.addEventListener('pointerdown',function skip(){clearTimeout(t);land();window.removeEventListener('pointerdown',skip);},{once:true});
      seal.addEventListener('animationend',land,{once:true});
    }
  } else {seal.classList.add('play');bloom.classList.add('play');}

  /* ---------- forms: save to Vercel KV via /api/submit ---------- */
  function wire(id,mid,type){
    var f=document.getElementById(id),m=document.getElementById(mid);if(!f)return;
    var btn=f.querySelector('button[type=submit]'),okText=btn.textContent,okMsg=m.textContent;
    f.addEventListener('submit',function(ev){
      ev.preventDefault();
      if(!f.checkValidity()){f.reportValidity();return;}
      btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Sending…';
      var fd=new FormData(f),obj={type:type};
      fd.forEach(function(v,k){obj[k]=v;});
      fetch('/api/submit',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(obj)})
        .then(function(r){return r.json().then(function(j){return {ok:r.ok,j:j};},function(){return {ok:r.ok,j:{}};});})
        .then(function(res){
          btn.disabled=false;
          if(res.ok&&res.j&&res.j.success){m.textContent=okMsg;m.classList.add('show');btn.textContent='Received';setTimeout(function(){f.reset();btn.textContent=okText;},1600);}
          else if(res.j&&res.j.error==='email required'){m.textContent='Please add your email.';m.classList.add('show');btn.textContent=okText;}
          else{m.textContent='Could not save, please try again.';m.classList.add('show');btn.textContent=okText;}
        })
        .catch(function(){btn.disabled=false;m.textContent='Network hiccup, please try again.';m.classList.add('show');btn.textContent=okText;});
    });
  }
  wire('rosterForm','rosterMsg','roster');
  wire('listForm','listMsg','mailing');

  /* ---------- donate: selectable tier + frequency ---------- */
  (function(){
    var st={amt:50,freq:'once'};
    var amtEl=document.getElementById('giveAmt'),perEl=document.getElementById('givePer'),
        impEl=document.getElementById('giveImpact'),btn=document.getElementById('giveBtn');
    if(!amtEl)return;
    function impact(a){return a>=250?'sponsors a whole neighborhood night':a>=100?'funds a full set, start to finish':a>=50?'puts a musician on the block':'helps pay a musician fairly';}
    function render(){
      amtEl.textContent=st.amt;
      perEl.textContent=st.freq==='monthly'?'/mo':'';
      impEl.textContent=impact(st.amt);
      btn.textContent='Donate $'+st.amt+(st.freq==='monthly'?'/mo':'');
      btn.href='https://givebutter.com/sustainable-music-northwest?amount='+st.amt+(st.freq==='monthly'?'&frequency=monthly':'');
    }
    document.getElementById('giveChips').addEventListener('click',function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
      st.amt=+b.dataset.amt;
      this.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('on',x===b);});
      render();
    });
    document.getElementById('giveFreq').addEventListener('click',function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
      st.freq=b.dataset.freq;
      this.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('on',x===b);});
      render();
    });
    render();
  })();

  /* ===== inline visual editor ===== */
  var CONTENT={};
  function applyContent(){
    Object.keys(CONTENT).forEach(function(k){
      var v=CONTENT[k];
      var t=document.querySelector('[data-edit="'+k+'"]');
      if(t){t.innerHTML=v;return;}
      var im=document.querySelector('[data-edit-img="'+k+'"]');
      if(im){ if(im.tagName==='IMG'){im.src=v;} else {im.style.backgroundImage='url("'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'")';} }
    });
  }
  fetch('/api/content').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(d){CONTENT=d.content||{};applyContent();galInit();}).catch(function(){});

  function adminKey(){try{return localStorage.getItem('smnw-admin');}catch(e){return null;}}
  function setAdminKey(k){try{k?localStorage.setItem('smnw-admin',k):localStorage.removeItem('smnw-admin');}catch(e){}}
  var dirty={};

  var adlogin=document.getElementById('adlogin'),adpw=document.getElementById('adpw'),aderr=document.getElementById('aderr');
  var keyhole=document.getElementById('adminKeyhole');
  if(keyhole)keyhole.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();openLogin();});
  function openLogin(){ if(adminKey()){enterEdit();return;} if(!adlogin)return; adlogin.hidden=false;aderr.textContent='';adpw.value='';setTimeout(function(){adpw.focus();},30); }
  if(adlogin){
    document.getElementById('adcancel').addEventListener('click',function(){adlogin.hidden=true;});
    document.getElementById('adgo').addEventListener('click',doLogin);
    adpw.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter')doLogin();});
    adlogin.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===adlogin)adlogin.hidden=true;});
  }
  function doLogin(){
    var k=adpw.value.trim(); if(!k)return; aderr.textContent='Checking…';
    fetch('/api/admin',{headers:{'x-admin-key':k}}).then(function(r){
      if(r.ok){setAdminKey(k);adlogin.hidden=true;showLauncher();enterEdit();}
      else{aderr.textContent='Wrong password.';}
    }).catch(function(){aderr.textContent='Try again.';});
  }

  function showLauncher(){ if(document.getElementById('edLaunch')||document.body.classList.contains('editing'))return;
    var b=document.createElement('button');b.id='edLaunch';b.className='edLaunch';b.textContent='✎ Edit page';
    b.addEventListener('click',enterEdit);document.body.appendChild(b); }
  function hideLauncher(){var l=document.getElementById('edLaunch');if(l)l.remove();}
  if(adminKey())showLauncher();

  function resizeImg(file,max,q,cb){
    var img=new Image(),url=URL.createObjectURL(file);
    img.onload=function(){var w=img.width,h=img.height,s=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(w,h));
      var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.round(w*s);c.height=Math.round(h*s);
      c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,c.width,c.height);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',q));};
    img.onerror=function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);};img.src=url;
  }
  function pickImage(el,key){
    var inp=document.createElement('input');inp.type='file';inp.accept='image/*';
    inp.onchange=function(){var f=inp.files&&inp.files[0];if(!f)return;resizeImg(f,1400,0.72,function(u){if(el.tagName==='IMG')el.src=u;else el.style.backgroundImage='url("'+u+'")';dirty[key]=u;updateBar();});};
    inp.click();
  }
  function cleanHTML(el){
    var tmp=el.cloneNode(true),ok={EM:1,B:1,STRONG:1,I:1,BR:1,A:1};
    Array.prototype.slice.call(tmp.querySelectorAll('*')).forEach(function(n){
      if(!ok[n.tagName]){var p=n.parentNode;while(n.firstChild)p.insertBefore(n.firstChild,n);p.removeChild(n);}
      else{Array.prototype.slice.call(n.attributes).forEach(function(a){if(!(n.tagName==='A'&&a.name==='href'))n.removeAttribute(a.name);});}
    });
    return tmp.innerHTML.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  }
  function enterEdit(){
    if(!adminKey())return; hideLauncher(); document.body.classList.add('editing');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(function(el){
      el.setAttribute('contenteditable','true'); el.setAttribute('spellcheck','false');
      el.addEventListener('input',onInput);
      el.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'&&/^(H1|H2|H3|H4|CITE|SPAN)$/.test(el.tagName)){e.preventDefault();el.blur();}});
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-img]').forEach(function(el){el.addEventListener('click',onImgClick);});
    renderGallery();renderAll();
    buildBar();
  }
  function onInput(e){var el=e.currentTarget;dirty[el.getAttribute('data-edit')]=cleanHTML(el);updateBar();}
  function onImgClick(e){ if(!document.body.classList.contains('editing'))return; e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation(); pickImage(e.currentTarget,e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-edit-img')); }
  function buildBar(){
    if(document.getElementById('edbar'))return;
    var bar=document.createElement('div');bar.className='edbar';bar.id='edbar';
    bar.innerHTML='<span class="lbl">Editing</span><button id="edSave" class="primary" disabled>Save</button><button id="edDone">Done</button><a class="edlink" href="/admin.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Submissions ↗</a><button id="edLogout" class="edlink">Log out</button>';
    document.body.appendChild(bar);
    document.getElementById('edSave').addEventListener('click',saveEdits);
    document.getElementById('edDone').addEventListener('click',doneEdits);
    document.getElementById('edLogout').addEventListener('click',function(){setAdminKey(null);location.reload();});
  }
  function updateBar(){var s=document.getElementById('edSave');if(!s)return;var n=Object.keys(dirty).length;s.disabled=!n;s.textContent=n?('Save · '+n):'Save';}
  function doneEdits(){
    if(Object.keys(dirty).length){ if(!confirm('Discard unsaved changes?'))return; location.reload(); return; }
    document.body.classList.remove('editing');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(function(el){el.removeAttribute('contenteditable');});
    applyContent();
    renderGallery();renderAll();
    var b=document.getElementById('edbar');if(b)b.remove(); showLauncher();
  }
  function saveEdits(){
    var s=document.getElementById('edSave');s.disabled=true;s.textContent='Saving…';
    fetch('/api/content',{method:'POST',headers:{'x-admin-key':adminKey(),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({updates:dirty})})
      .then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(res){
        if(res&&res.success){ Object.keys(dirty).forEach(function(k){CONTENT[k]=dirty[k];}); dirty={}; s.textContent='Saved ✓'; setTimeout(function(){updateBar();},1300); }
        else if(res&&res.error==='unauthorized'){alert('Please log in again.');setAdminKey(null);location.reload();}
        else{s.disabled=false;s.textContent='Save';alert('Save failed. Try again.');}
      }).catch(function(){s.disabled=false;s.textContent='Save';alert('Network error while saving.');});
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   BLOCK STAGE NATIVE CLIENT CONTROLLER
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
  const TIERS = [
    { name: 'Solo Acoustic', cost: 500 },
    { name: 'Duo (Base)', cost: 850 },
    { name: 'Trio', cost: 1200 },
    { name: 'Quartet', cost: 1640 },
    { name: 'Quintet', cost: 2050 },
    { name: 'Sextet', cost: 2450 },
    { name: '7-Piece Big Band', cost: 2850 }
  ];

  let currentCampaigns = [];
  let selectedCampaign = null;

  async function fetchActiveDrives() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/campaigns/active');
      const data = await res.json();
      currentCampaigns = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      if (currentCampaigns.length > 0) {
        selectCampaign(currentCampaigns[0]);
      }
      renderDrivesList();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Could not load active drives:', err);
    }
  }

  function renderDrivesList() {
    const listEl = document.getElementById('bsDrivesList');
    if (!listEl) return;
    if (currentCampaigns.length === 0) {
      listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text-muted);">No active drives right now. Be the first to initiate one!</p>';
      return;
    }
    listEl.innerHTML = currentCampaigns.map((c, i) => `
      <div class="drive-card ${selectedCampaign && selectedCampaign.id === c.id ? 'active' : ''}" data-idx="${i}">
        <h4>${c.title}</h4>
        <p>Target: ${c.target_event_date} · Raised $${c.raised.toLocaleString()}</p>
      </div>
    `).join('');

    listEl.querySelectorAll('.drive-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const idx = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-idx'), 10);
        selectCampaign(currentCampaigns[idx]);
      });
    });
  }

  function selectCampaign(c) {
    selectedCampaign = c;
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveTitle');
    const metaEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveMeta');
    const raisedEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveRaised');
    const goalEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveGoal');
    const descEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveDesc');
    const barEl = document.getElementById('bsProgressBar');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveStatus');
    const pledgeBtn = document.getElementById('bsPledgeDirectBtn');

    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = c.title;
    if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = `Target: ${c.target_event_date} · Champion: ${c.champion_name}`;
    if (raisedEl) raisedEl.textContent = `$${c.raised.toLocaleString()}`;
    if (goalEl) goalEl.textContent = `of $${c.goal.toLocaleString()} Stretch Goal`;
    if (descEl) descEl.textContent = c.description;
    if (pledgeBtn) pledgeBtn.href = c.url || 'https://givebutter.com';

    const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((c.raised / 2850) * 100));
    if (barEl) barEl.style.width = pct + '%';

    if (c.raised >= 2850) {
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = '🎉 7-Piece Big Band Fully Unlocked!';
    } else if (c.raised >= 850) {
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = '✅ Show Confirmed! Pushing to Stretch Goals';
    } else {
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = `Reaching for $850 Base Duo ($${850 - c.raised} to go)`;
    }

    renderTiersGrid(c.raised);
    renderDrivesList();
  }

  function renderTiersGrid(raised) {
    const gridEl = document.getElementById('bsTiersGrid');
    if (!gridEl) return;
    gridEl.innerHTML = TIERS.map(t => {
      const unlocked = raised >= t.cost;
      return `
        <div class="tier-col ${unlocked ? 'unlocked' : ''}">
          <div class="amt">$${t.cost.toLocaleString()}</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.75rem;margin-top:2px;">${t.name}</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.7rem;margin-top:4px;color:${unlocked ? '#0f766e' : 'var(--text-muted)'};">
            ${unlocked ? '✓ Unlocked' : 'Locked'}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  // Modal Setup
  const modalEl = document.getElementById('bsIntakeModal');
  const btnOpen = document.getElementById('btnOpenBsModal');
  const btnClose = document.getElementById('btnCloseBsModal');
  const formEl = document.getElementById('bsIntakeForm');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('bsSubmitBtn');

  if (btnOpen && modalEl) btnOpen.addEventListener('click', () => modalEl.classList.add('open'));
  if (btnClose && modalEl) btnClose.addEventListener('click', () => modalEl.classList.remove('open'));

  if (formEl) {
    formEl.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (submitBtn) {
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitBtn.textContent = 'Provisioning & Generating Flyer...';
      }

      const formData = new FormData(formEl);
      const payload = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/campaigns/create', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          if (modalEl) modalEl.classList.remove('open');
          formEl.reset();

          if (data.flyer_data_url || data.flyer_pdf_url) {
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = data.flyer_data_url || data.flyer_pdf_url;
            a.download = `BlockStage-Flyer-${(payload.neighborhood_title || 'Block').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}.pdf`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            a.remove();
          }

          alert('🎉 Congratulations! Your Block Stage campaign is live and your customized print-ready flyer has been downloaded. A confirmation email with the flyer attached has also been sent to ' + payload.champion_email);
          fetchActiveDrives();
        } else {
          alert('Error: ' + (data.message || 'Could not provision campaign.'));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        alert('Submission failed. Please check your network connection.');
      } finally {
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          submitBtn.textContent = 'Create Campaign & Download Flyer';
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Hook into SPA View Router changes
  const origShowView = window.showView;
  if (typeof origShowView === 'function') {
    window.showView = function(name, scrollTarget) {
      origShowView(name, scrollTarget);
      if (name === 'blockstage') {
        fetchActiveDrives();
      }
    };
  }

  // Initial call on document ready
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    fetchActiveDrives();
  });
})();
</script>

<script id="bs-native-logic">
(function() {
  const TIERS = [
    { name: 'Solo Acoustic', cost: 500, desc: 'Acoustic soloist set with sound equipment.' },
    { name: 'Duo (2-Person)', cost: 850, base: true, desc: 'Base goal confirms event! 2 vetted artists and full sound gear.' },
    { name: 'Trio (3-Person)', cost: 1250, desc: 'Expanded 3-piece combo with full dynamic sound.' },
    { name: 'Quartet (4-Piece)', cost: 1640, desc: 'Full 4-piece rhythm section (jazz, soul, or funk outfit).' },
    { name: 'Quintet (5-Piece)', cost: 2050, desc: 'High-energy 5-piece band with horns or percussion for neighborhood street dancing.' },
    { name: 'Sextet (6-Piece)', cost: 2450, desc: 'Expanded 6-piece collective featuring multi-piece horn section.' },
    { name: '7-Piece Big Band', cost: 2850, desc: 'Ultimate headliner ensemble with full horn section and extended rhythm.' }
  ];

  let liveCampaigns = [];
  let selectedIdx = 0;

  const modalExplainer = document.getElementById('modalExplainer');
  const modalIntake = document.getElementById('modalIntake');
  const formIntake = document.getElementById('bsIntakeForm');
  const btnSubmit = document.getElementById('btnSubmitCampaign');

  function openModal(m) { if (m) m.classList.add('open'); }
  function closeModal(m) { if (m) m.classList.remove('open'); }

  document.getElementById('btnHeroBookConcert')?.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(modalIntake));
  document.getElementById('btnBottomBookParty')?.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(modalIntake));
  document.getElementById('btnOpenExplainerModal')?.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(modalExplainer));
  document.getElementById('btnCloseExplainer')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal(modalExplainer));
  document.getElementById('btnCloseIntake')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal(modalIntake));
  document.getElementById('btnExplainerToBook')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    closeModal(modalExplainer);
    openModal(modalIntake);
  });

  async function loadCampaigns() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/campaigns/active');
      const list = await res.json();
      if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
        liveCampaigns = list;
        renderDrivesList();
        selectCampaign(0);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not load campaigns:', e);
    }
  }

  function renderDrivesList() {
    const listContainer = document.getElementById('bsActiveDrivesList');
    if (!listContainer) return;
    listContainer.innerHTML = liveCampaigns.map((item, idx) => `
      <div class="drive-select-card" data-idx="${idx}" style="padding:1.2rem;background:${idx === selectedIdx ? '#1c2433' : '#151c28'};border:1px solid ${idx === selectedIdx ? '#dca842' : '#233044'};border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:0.75rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;">
        <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;color:#ffffff;margin-bottom:0.3rem;">${item.title}</div>
        <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#94a3b8;">Target Date: ${item.target_event_date} · Raised $${item.raised.toLocaleString()} of $${item.goal.toLocaleString()}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');

    listContainer.querySelectorAll('.drive-select-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const idx = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-idx'), 10);
        selectCampaign(idx);
      });
    });
  }

  function selectCampaign(idx) {
    selectedIdx = idx;
    const c = liveCampaigns[idx];
    if (!c) return;

    // 1. Update Title and About section
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('bsActiveTitle');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = c.title;

    const aboutText = document.querySelector('#v-blockstage .section-card > p.subtext');
    if (aboutText) aboutText.textContent = `Primary 4-Piece Target: $1,640 | Max 7-Piece Headliner: $2,850`;

    // 2. Update Direct Pledge button on the right card
    const pledgeBtn = document.getElementById('btnChipInDirect');
    if (pledgeBtn) pledgeBtn.href = c.url || 'https://givebutter.com';

    // 3. Update Progress Bar
    const barEl = document.getElementById('bsProgressBar');
    const raised = parseFloat(c.raised) || 0;
    const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((raised / 2850) * 100));
    if (barEl) barEl.style.width = pct + '%';

    // 4. Update the 7 Tiers Grid
    const tiersContainer = document.querySelector('#v-blockstage .tiers-grid');
    if (tiersContainer) {
      tiersContainer.innerHTML = TIERS.map(t => {
        let isUnlocked = raised >= t.cost;
        let isBaseGoal = t.base;
        let pillClass = 'locked';
        let pillText = 'Locked';

        if (isUnlocked && isBaseGoal) {
          pillClass = 'confirmed';
          pillText = 'Event Confirmed!';
        } else if (isUnlocked) {
          pillClass = 'unlocked';
          pillText = 'Unlocked!';
        } else if (raised > 0 && raised < t.cost && (raised >= (t.cost - 400))) {
          pillClass = 'split';
          pillText = `$${raised} / $${t.cost}`;
        }

        return `
          <div class="tier-box ${pillClass}">
            <span class="tier-pill ${pillClass}">${pillText}</span>
            <div class="tier-name">${t.name}</div>
            <div class="tier-cost">$${t.cost.toLocaleString()} ${isBaseGoal ? '(Base Goal)' : 'Target'}</div>
            <p class="tier-desc">${t.desc}</p>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    renderDrivesList();
  }

  // Handle Form Submission
  formIntake?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (btnSubmit) {
      btnSubmit.disabled = true;
      btnSubmit.textContent = 'Creating Booking Page & Flyer...';
    }

    const payload = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(formIntake).entries());

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/campaigns/create', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      const data = await res.json();

      if (data.success) {
        closeModal(modalIntake);
        formIntake.reset();

        if (data.flyer_data_url || data.flyer_pdf_url) {
          const dl = document.createElement('a');
          dl.href = data.flyer_data_url || data.flyer_pdf_url;
          dl.download = `BlockStage-Flyer-${(payload.neighborhood_title || 'Block').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}.pdf`;
          document.body.appendChild(dl);
          dl.click();
          dl.remove();
        }

        alert('🎉 Congratulations! Your Block Stage campaign is live and your customized print-ready flyer has been downloaded. A confirmation email with the flyer attached has also been sent to ' + payload.champion_email);
        loadCampaigns();
      } else {
        alert('Error: ' + (data.message || 'Could not provision campaign.'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Submission failed. Please check your network connection.');
    } finally {
      if (btnSubmit) {
        btnSubmit.disabled = false;
        btnSubmit.textContent = 'Create Our Block Campaign & Flyer';
      }
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadCampaigns);
})();
</script>

<script id="bs-router-patch">
(function() {
  function activateView(name) {
    const targetId = (name === 'blockstage') ? 'v-blockstage' : ('v-' + name);
    const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
    
    // Hide all views
    document.querySelectorAll('main.view').forEach(function(el) {
      el.classList.remove('active');
      el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    });

    // Show only the requested view
    if (targetEl) {
      targetEl.classList.add('active');
      targetEl.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }
  }

  // Intercept navigation clicks across header, footer, and buttons
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    const link = e.target.closest('[data-go]');
    if (link) {
      const destination = link.getAttribute('data-go');
      if (destination) {
        e.preventDefault();
        activateView(destination);
      }
    }
  }, true);

  // Wrap the existing global showView if present
  const originalShowView = window.showView;
  window.showView = function(viewName, scrollTarget) {
    activateView(viewName);
    if (typeof originalShowView === 'function') {
      try { originalShowView(viewName, scrollTarget); } catch(err) {}
    }
  };

  // If the page loads with #blockstage in the URL, immediately show it
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (window.location.hash === '#blockstage') {
      activateView('blockstage');
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script id="bs-canonical-engine">
(function() {
  // Modal Elements
  const modalExplainer = document.getElementById('modalExplainer');
  const modalIntake = document.getElementById('modalIntake');
  const formIntake = document.getElementById('bsIntakeForm');
  const btnSubmit = document.getElementById('btnSubmitCampaign');

  function openM(m) {
    if (m) {
      m.classList.add('open');
      m.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
    }
  }

  function closeM(m) {
    if (m) {
      m.classList.remove('open');
      m.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    }
  }

  window.openExplainerModal = function() { openM(modalExplainer); };
  window.closeExplainerModal = function() { closeM(modalExplainer); };
  window.openIntakeModal = function() { openM(modalIntake); };
  window.closeIntakeModal = function() { closeM(modalIntake); };

  // Modal open/close button bindings
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target.closest('#btnHeroBookConcert, #btnBottomBookParty, [data-open="intake"]')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      openM(modalIntake);
    } else if (e.target.closest('#btnOpenExplainerModal, [data-open="explainer"]')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      openM(modalExplainer);
    } else if (e.target.closest('#btnCloseExplainer')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeM(modalExplainer);
    } else if (e.target.closest('#btnCloseIntake, .bs-modal-close')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeM(modalIntake);
      closeM(modalExplainer);
    } else if (e.target.closest('#btnExplainerToBook')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeM(modalExplainer);
      openM(modalIntake);
    }
  });

  // Global Page / Router navigation clicks
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    const link = e.target.closest('[data-go]');
    if (link) {
      const destination = link.getAttribute('data-go');
      const scrollId = link.getAttribute('data-scroll');
      if (destination && typeof window.showView === 'function') {
        e.preventDefault();
        window.showView(destination, scrollId);
      }
    }
  });

  // SINGLE Campaign Form Submitter with in-flight lock
  let isSubmittingCampaign = false;

  if (formIntake) {
    formIntake.onsubmit = async function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isSubmittingCampaign) return;
      isSubmittingCampaign = true;

      const origText = btnSubmit ? btnSubmit.textContent : 'Submit';
      if (btnSubmit) {
        btnSubmit.disabled = true;
        btnSubmit.textContent = 'Creating Booking Page & Flyer...';
      }

      const payload = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(formIntake).entries());

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/campaigns/create', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const data = await res.json();

        if (data.success) {
          closeM(modalIntake);
          formIntake.reset();

          // Auto-download promotional flyer
          const downloadUrl = data.flyer_data_url || data.flyer_pdf_url;
          if (downloadUrl) {
            const dl = document.createElement('a');
            dl.href = downloadUrl;
            dl.download = 'BlockStage-Flyer-' + (payload.neighborhood_title || 'Block').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_') + '.pdf';
            document.body.appendChild(dl);
            dl.click();
            dl.remove();
          }

          alert('🎉 Congratulations! Your Block Stage campaign is live and your customized print-ready flyer has been downloaded. A confirmation email with the flyer attached has been sent to ' + payload.champion_email);
          if (typeof loadCampaigns === 'function') loadCampaigns();
        } else {
          alert('Error: ' + (data.message || 'Could not provision campaign.'));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        alert('Submission failed. Please check your network connection.');
      } finally {
        isSubmittingCampaign = false;
        if (btnSubmit) {
          btnSubmit.disabled = false;
          btnSubmit.textContent = origText;
        }
      }
    };
  }
})();
</script>
